mechanism: Cumulative delta divergence from tick volume on M15-H1 identifies session-boundary liquidity sweeps where order-flow imbalance precedes directional reversal or continuation.
falsifiable_prediction: On FTMO MT5 symbols, tick-volume cumulative delta divergence on M15-H1 correlates with subsequent price direction more often than random assignment in post-hoc labeling of liquidity sweeps at session transitions.
market_structure_assumption: Order-flow imbalance visible in tick-volume cumulative delta precedes price reversals at identifiable liquidity zones near session boundaries.
instrument_scope: FX majors EURUSD GBPUSD USDJPY and indices US30 US100 GER40 on FTMO/MT5.
required_data: MT5 tick volume for selected symbols OHLCV M15-H1 bars session timestamp labels London-New York overlap.
expected_failure_modes: Tick volume may not reflect true order flow across brokers
Spread costs during high-impact news can overwhelm edge
False signals during overlapping low-volatility periods
invalidation_criteria: Average adverse move exceeds average favorable move in validation sample
Signal generation rate below 1 per week on any symbol
Correlation between cumulative delta divergence and subsequent price direction not distinguishable from random walk
Spread costs regularly exceed 50% of average favorable move magnitude
implementation_shape: Rule-based: rolling cumulative delta from tick volume; detect divergence between price and delta; filter by London-New York overlap session; trail stop to recent swing extreme.
execution_sensitivity: Spread-sensitive ECN conditions preferred; swap-sensitive for holds beyond daily roll; session timing critical London-New York overlap only.
mt5_ftmo_concerns: FTMO challenge lot-size limits and consistency rules constrain position sizing; tick volume may lack true order-book depth in standard MT5; no DOM data available.
prior_related_lessons: Use only deterministic captured source artifacts as evidence provider-native knowledge is not evidence
